seoDescription: Quarterly commentary letters from Summit Asset Management.
heading: Quarterly commentary.
intro: Each quarter we send a commentary letter to our clients and friends. This letter contains our latest views on investments, the economy, and pertinent personal financial issues that may be of interest to clients.
imageAlt: Hands holding a pair of reading glasses at a table
archiveNote: From time to time we also publish special commentaries to share our thoughts on time-sensitive issues or to provide information on a current topic. Each letter reflects the views and conditions at the time it was written.
